title: Mystery: Unit 44

mystery.reveal_text: The bolt cutters bite. The door rattles up…

clues.probe: Mind if I knock on the door panel?
clues.low: You rap the door. A thin, hollow echo — like knocking on an empty biscuit tin.
clues.mid: You rap the door. Dull, solid thuds. Something's stacked against it — furniture, maybe boxes.
clues.high: You rap the door. Something DENSE shifts inside. A slow metallic slide, then a clink.

clues.probe: Who rented it, do you know?
clues.low: "College kid. Skipped town mid-semester owing two months. You know the type."
clues.mid: "Quiet couple, paid on time for six years, then just… stopped. Moved abroad, I heard."
clues.high: "Older gentleman. Collector type — always paid cash, always locked it himself. Fussy about the humidity, which, you know. Says something."

clues.probe: Any chance of a peek through the vent?
clues.low: You squint through the vent. Dusty plastic bins and what might be a deflated air mattress.
clues.mid: You squint through the vent. A guitar case, taped boxes, something draped in a moving blanket.
clues.high: You squint through the vent. Darkness — then your phone light catches the corner of a glass display case.

tagline: A sealed storage unit. Could be treasure. Could be a deflated air mattress. Your call.
public_context:
**SELF-STORE 24 — DELINQUENT UNIT SALE.** Unit 44's renter stopped paying months ago. Contents: sealed, unknown, sold as-is. The facility manager, Pat, has the bolt cutters and somewhere better to be.

Whatever's inside is yours the moment you agree a price. *After* you agree a price.

player_role.name: Bargain Hunter
player_role.persona: A weekend reseller with a van, a flashlight, and a gambler's heart.
player_role.private_brief:
Units like this can hold anything from mildewed cardboard to estate treasure.

- Your working capital is about **$600** — losses are real money.
- Pat has seen a thousand of these and gives NOTHING away for free. But you're allowed to poke around the outside… and Pat does like to chat.
- Rule of thumb in the trade: a blind unit is 'worth' about **$300** — but this one is whatever THIS one is.

batna.description: Keep your cash and hit the estate sales on Sunday instead.

ai_role.name: Pat (facility manager)
ai_role.persona: Seen-it-all storage manager with a clipboard and zero sentimentality.
ai_role.private_brief: You're Pat. Corporate wants delinquent units GONE. You don't know what's in 44 either — and you've stopped caring what's in any of them.

batna.description: Let the clearance crew haul it — which costs the facility money and paperwork.

personality.style_prompt: You are Pat: dry, unhurried, mildly amused by treasure hunters. Short sentences. You've genuinely no idea what's in the unit and say so when pushed — but you'll happily share what you remember about tenants and let buyers knock on doors; watching them guess is the best part of this job. Never invent facts about the contents beyond what you're given. 1-3 sentences, first person.

hidden_info.fact: Corporate wants every delinquent unit cleared by Friday. If it doesn't sell, YOU pay the haul-away crew out of the site budget — so honestly, most any offer beats that.
hidden_info.probe: How soon do you need this thing gone?

hidden_info.fact: A couple of resale dealers usually cruise the lot on Saturdays. If this buyer walks, there's a fair chance someone else bites — you're not desperate, just tidy.
hidden_info.probe: Anyone else been sniffing around it?

talking_points: Best thing ever found in a unit here: a canoe full of taxidermy owls.
Worst thing: forty boxes labeled 'misc'. All accurate.

arcade.mission: Unit 44 is sealed. Whatever's inside minus what you pay is your score — knock, peek, and quiz Pat for clues, then bid. Yes, you can end up in the red.
arcade.short_mission: 📦 Contents unknown — score = what's inside − what you pay
player_hud: 📐 Blind units run ~$300 in the trade

points.label: Bought under the $300 rule of thumb

events.player_note: A van with 'R&J ESTATE BUYERS' on the side rolls slowly past the row of units. Pat checks their watch.
events.ai_note: The Saturday dealers are early. Leverage. Use it, mildly.
